approved.en: Russia launched missile and cluster warhead attacks on Kyiv hours after agreeing to resume peace talks, killing at least nine civilians and injuring 57, while also striking other parts of Ukraine. Ukrainian forces disclosed a new cruise missile named Filin and reported infiltration of Russian rear areas through gas pipelines near Kupiansk and Khartiia. Ukraine announced a reduction in reliance on Chinese drones but noted critical capability gaps remain. Hackers linked to Russia employed a decentralised network in a cyberattack against Ukrainian targets. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Israeli forces are intensifying attacks on West Bank olive farmers and conducting deadly strikes in Gaza, while UNICEF reports that 340 children have been killed in Gaza despite a ceasefire. Israeli settlers are expanding outposts and seizing land, prompting far-right activists to block Gaza aid trucks, and the Israeli military has imposed restrictions on engine oil that are crippling the humanitarian response. The IDF asserts that Hamas can only be dismantled through renewed fighting in Gaza, and four Palestinians have been killed by the IDF in Gaza amid reports of a severe flour shortage.

Israelske bosettere utvider utposter og beslaglegger land, noe som får høyreekstreme aktivister til å blokkere hjelpelaster til Gaza, og den israelske hæren har innført restriksjoner på motorolje som lammer den humanitære responsen. IDF hevder at Hamas kun kan demonteres gjennom fornyet kamp i Gaza, og fire palestinere er blitt drept av IDF i Gaza midt i rapporter om en alvorlig melkesnøpp.

approved.en: Hezbollah explosives seized from two Lebanese trucks have led Lebanon's prime minister and security forces to promise a thorough investigation while Israeli artillery and air strikes continue against Hezbollah positions in southern Lebanon, causing civilian casualties. In northern Israel a Hezbollah submunition exploded in a teenager's backpack, killing Elazar Yair Wilensky and wounding dozens, prompting an IDF probe and possible hike restrictions. Qatar has pledged funding for reconstruction in southern Lebanon, announced a massive solar plant project, and its foreign minister called for Israeli withdrawal from Lebanon. The UCDP recorded 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

I Nord-Israel eksploderte en Hezbollah-submunisjon i en tenårings ryggsekk, og drepte Elazar Yair Wilensky og såret dusinvis, noe som har ført til en IDF-undersøkelse og mulige restriksjoner på høyde. Qatar har lovet finansiering til gjenoppbygging i Sør-Libanon, kunngjort et massivt solkraftprosjekt, og utenriksministeren oppfordret til israelsk tilbaketrekning fra Libanon. UCDP registrerte 4 335 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Sudanese armed forces carried out a drone strike on Abyei's Amiet market, killing dozens and injuring many, and a separate drone strike hit a market in the disputed Abyei border region, also causing high casualties. Communal clashes continued, including 14 deaths between Warrap and Lakes communities and the arrest of a traditional chief over a Juba youth killing. Fresh attacks in Ruweng left nine dead and six wounded, and bodies arrived from the Khor Kaltan killings in Northern Bahr el Ghazal. The UCDP recorded two battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Den sudanske hæren utførte et droneangrep på Amiet-markedet i Abyei, der drepte dusinvis og såret mange, og et separat droneangrep rammet et marked i den omstridte grenseområdet Abyei, også med høye tap. Kommunale sammenstøt fortsatte, inkludert 14 dødsfall mellom Warrap- og Lakes-samfunnene og arrestasjonen av en tradisjonell høvding over en drap på en ungdom i Juba. Nye angrep i Ruweng etterlot ni døde og seks sårede, og lik ankom fra drapene i Khor Kaltan i Nord-Bahr el Ghazal. UCDP registrerte to kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Ethiopian forces have installed a caretaker administration in Tigray and are moving toward the Eritrean border, while a pro-government militia says it seized the regional airport and reports Eritrean forces suffered losses there. The United States, through Secretary of State Marco Rubio, is urging Ethiopia and Eritrea to de-escalate, and Mekelle mayor Shishay Amare announced elections within six months to settle Western Tigray through constitutional processes. A drone strike in the disputed Abyei region killed at least 73 people, and the TPLF claims to have killed 1,511 Ethiopian soldiers in recent fighting. The conflict caused 2,824 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

USA, gjennom utenriksminister Marco Rubio, oppfordrer Etiopia og Eritrea til å de-eskalere, og Mekelle borgermester Shishay Amare kunngjorde valg innen seks måneder for å løse Vest-Tigray gjennom konstitusjonelle prosesser. Et droneangrep i det omstridte Abyei-området drepte minst 73 personer, og TPLF hevder å ha drept 1 511 etiopiske soldater i nylige kamper. Konflikten forårsaket 2 824 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Fitgharan forces now control the Mogadishu-Baidoa corridor while Laftagareen forces have seized Buurhakaba and another town in the Bay region, expanding fighting in southern Somalia. Al Shabaab detonated an IED in Mandera, injuring six civilians, and the ICRC treated 148 wounded after heavy combat in Baidoa. Ethiopia announced the withdrawal of more than 3,000 troops from Somalia as its own civil war intensifies and has refused to intervene in the South West State conflict. The UAE carried out its first drone strike in nearly a year, killing four family members including a pregnant teenager in Puntland, and the US and UAE launched airstrikes against al-Shabaab in northern Somalia. 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Al Shabaab detonerte en IED i Mandera, og seks sivile ble skadet, og Røde Kors behandlet 148 sårede etter tungt kamphandling i Baidoa. Etiopia kunngjorde at mer enn 3 000 soldater trekkes tilbake fra Somalia ettersom den interne borgerkrigen i landet intensiveres, og har nektet å intervenere i konflikten i South West State. De forente arabiske emirater gjennomførte sitt første droneangrep på nesten ett år, og drepte fire familiemedlemmer, inkludert en gravid tenåring, i Puntland, og USA og De forente arabiske emirater utførte luftangrep mot al Shabaab i Nord-Somalia. 2 284 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

I Niger drepte et angrep på busser i nord minst 12 personer, og to europeiske gisler ble løslatt. En domstol i Mopti prøvde 69 maliske soldater for påståtte forbrytelser. approved.en: Gunmen in Plateau killed NSCDC officer Distu Garba Audu and abducted a businessman, while bandits in Kaduna abducted five people, including a one-month-old baby, and demanded N10 million for a teacher's release. Troops rescued four abducted victims in Zamfara and Kebbi and police freed a Catholic priest and seven other abductees in Benue. Bandits killed passengers in road attacks in Sokoto and intercepted a vehicle, killing all passengers, and herders in Plateau were attacked, leaving two dead and six injured. The conflict produced 1,486 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Tropper reddet fire bortførte ofre i Zamfara og Kebbi, og politiet frigjorde en katolsk prest og syv andre bortførte i Benue. Banditter drepte passasjerer i veigrupper i Sokoto og avlyttet et kjøretøy, der alle passasjerer ble drept, og hyrder i Plateau ble angrepet, noe som førte til to døde og seks sårede. Konflikten førte til 1 486 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Cameroon’s BIR rapid intervention force has expanded its presence around Lake Chad, while the government continues to deploy drones and joint border patrols in the Anglophone regions. Survivors of the Eseka rail disaster are still waiting for justice ten years after the crash. A French court has greenlit a third-party funder’s enforcement of an ICC award against Cameroon. President Paul Biya, aged 93, remains in office despite frequent absences. The conflict caused 231 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
